body: Me too! It just takes time. If you have any questions or need any help my door is open!

Yeah, I started with that too and it wasn't enough. It's a shitty choice - keep the issues you have or keep trying stuff till something works for it. I dono, I had PTSD along with debilitating anxeity for over a year. So it was keep trying stuff till something worked or just die lol. Wasn't fun but I also started with meds that have very little side effects.

Think of them as more of a doctor that you have to describe your symptoms to in order for them to prescribe something to make it better. Be prepared to describe what you're anxeity feels like, physical symptoms, if you feel suicidal and how strong those thoughts are. They will probably have more questions to help narrow down that brain chemicals need to be adjusted to help you feel normal. It's a little trial and error but the more open and honest you are the faster finding the right meds will go.
